title: Refresh Linked Table (DataAndAutomation)

scenarios.title: Refresh Linked Table applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Refresh Linked Table (BtnRefreshLinkedTable) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Linked-table tag codec is pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The oPE_TableLink AlternativeText codec writes the flags token ('F' formatting, 'R' auto-resize, 'V' neither) and parses it back leniently: an optional flags token directly after the tag distinguishes the new format from the legacy flag-less layout (a workbook path can never look like a flags token), the range is always the last field, and interior pipes rejoin into the sheet name; malformed or non-tag payloads are rejected.
